method: Same author, separate prompt-first pass with answer fields omitted from the initial read, followed by comparison against stored keys and guides. Prior author context remained available: this is not independent human review or formal blinded validation. Numeric and sequence results are re-derived from the stated inputs; prior exact required-passage and source reviews remain distinct evidence. Two subsequent B STS applications were developed from the mapped required teaching: raw rates and conceptual limits were re-derived, and alternative justified value decisions are explicitly allowed. Read all65 prompts and answers against43 exact criteria; narrowed mappings without changing learner questions or keys.
